archetypes.name: dyn-report-flow
archetypes.rationale: Final report assembly order changed across two lifecycle paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the /design and /implement final report assembly changes. Verify review detail, execution issue detail, and architectural notes precede the run-summary marker without altering section content. Check that disk writes, stdout emission, run-log summaries, and tracking-issue upsert bodies all consume the same reordered body. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
